evidence.detail: tr.clickable:hover td:not(.marginalia) applies background highlight but no border-radius
Other hover/highlight elements (e.g. main a:hover) do use var(--text-rounded-corners)
Author frames this as a design question ('Should ... ?'), not a bug report

triage.notes: This is a CSS design consistency question — whether table row highlights should gain rounded corners or whether other rounded elements should lose them. Needs an owner's aesthetic judgment before any code change.
